Name: AnsibleController
Description: Ansible control node with automation tooling, linter, sshpass, and lab-ready ansible.cfg
RunCommands:
cat << 'EOF' > /home/labadmin/ansible-lab/ansible.cfg
[defaults]
inventory = inventory.ini
host_key_checking = False
interpreter_python = auto_silent
retry_files_enabled = False
stdout_callback = yaml

[privilege_escalation]
become = True
become_method = sudo
become_user = root
become_ask_pass = False
EOF
